source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 8 (PDF 234-255), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 8 (Numerical Solutions of Nonlinear Equations (TOC: 'Numerical Method')) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Show that \(f(x) = x^{4} - 4x^{3} + 2\) has at least two real roots by finding its intervals of sign change. (5 marks)
(Sign change ke intervals dhoond kar dikhayein ke \(f(x) = x^{4} - 4x^{3} + 2\) ke kam az kam do real roots hain.)
blocks.explanation: Continuity check karein, poore numbers par f ki table banayein, aur jahan sign badle wahan LRT lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Separate (non-overlapping) intervals of sign change give separate roots

steps: \(f\) polynomial hai, is liye har jagah continuous
LRT se \(]0, 1[\) mein aik root aur \(]3, 4[\) mein aik root; intervals alag hain
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(f\) ke kam az kam do real roots hain, aik \(]0, 1[\) mein, aik \(]3, 4[\) mein (taqreeban \(0.8604\) aur \(3.9680\)).

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the real root of \(f(x) = x^{3} + x - 1\) in \([0, 1]\) graphically, correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = x^{3} + x - 1\) ka \([0, 1]\) mein real root graph se do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Interval mein 0.1 ke qadmon par f ki table, graph, crossing parhein, phir sign test se rounding pakki karein.

book_ref.quote: Draw the graph of \(y = f(x)\) on \(xy\)-plane within the interval of sign change only.

steps: Sign 0.6 aur 0.7 ke darmiyan badalta hai; graph taqreeban \(x = 0.68\) par x-axis kaatta hai

blocks.prompt:
3 Use the bisection method to find a root of \(f(x) = x^{3} - 2x - 5\) in \([2, 3]\) correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Bisection method se \(f(x) = x^{3} - 2x - 5\) ka \([2, 3]\) mein root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har baar interval aadha karein, sign change wala hissa rakhein, aur \(|f(c)| < 0.005\) par rukein.

book_ref.quote: The method systematically halves the interval to narrow down the location of the root until the desired accuracy is reached.

blocks.prompt:
4 Use the bisection method to find the root of \(\cos x = 2x\) in \([0, 1]\) correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Bisection method se \(\cos x = 2x\) ka \([0, 1]\) mein root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = \cos x - 2x\) likhein, radian mode, aur woh end badlein jis ka sign \(f(c)\) jaisa ho.

book_ref.quote: How to decide which half to keep: look only at signs.

blocks.prompt:
5 Use the Regula-Falsi method to find the root of \(x^{3} + x - 1 = 0\) in \([0, 1]\) correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Regula-Falsi method se \(x^{3} + x - 1 = 0\) ka \([0, 1]\) mein root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(c = \frac{af(b) - bf(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\) lagayein aur sign change wala hissa rakhein; yahan \(b = 1\) nahin hilta.

book_ref.quote: The idea of Regula-Falsi is to approximate the root by drawing a straight line through the points

blocks.prompt:
6 Use the Regula-Falsi method to find a root of \(f(x) = x^{3} - 4x - 9\) in \([2, 3]\) correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Regula-Falsi se \(f(x) = x^{3} - 4x - 9\) ka \([2, 3]\) mein root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Secant formula manfi qeematon ko bracket mein rakh kar; har \(f(c)\) manfi hai, is liye \(a\) badalta hai, \(b = 3\) rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Write negative values in brackets when substituting

blocks.prompt:
7 Use the Regula-Falsi method to find the root of \(x^{3} - 2x - 5 = 0\) in \([2, 3]\) correct to two decimal places, and compare the number of iterations with bisection (which needs 10). (5 marks)
(Regula-Falsi se \(x^{3} - 2x - 5 = 0\) ka \([2, 3]\) mein root do decimal places tak nikalein, aur iterations ka bisection (10) se muqabla karein.)

book_ref.quote: It is usually faster than bisection

blocks.prompt:
8 Use the Newton-Raphson method with \(x_0 = 2\) to find the root of \(x^{3} - 2x - 5 = 0\) correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Newton-Raphson se \(x_0 = 2\) le kar \(x^{3} - 2x - 5 = 0\) ka root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f'(x)\) nikalein, \(x_0\) ke qareeb \(f'(x) \ne 0\) dekhein, phir \(x_{n+1} = x_n - \frac{f(x_n)}{f'(x_n)}\).

book_ref.quote: This method works by drawing a tangent to the curve

blocks.prompt:
9 Show that the Newton-Raphson iteration for \(\sqrt{N}\) is \(x_{n+1} = \frac{1}{2}\left(x_n + \frac{N}{x_n}\right)\). Hence find \(\sqrt{10}\) correct to three decimal places, starting from \(x_0 = 3\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(\sqrt{N}\) ke liye Newton-Raphson iteration \(x_{n+1} = \frac{1}{2}\left(x_n + \frac{N}{x_n}\right)\) hai. Phir \(x_0 = 3\) se \(\sqrt{10}\) teen decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sqrt{N}\), \(x^{2} - N = 0\) ka positive root hai; formula sada karein, phir tolerance 0.0005 se iterate karein.

book_ref.quote: Repeating this process produces a sequence of

blocks.prompt:
10 The equation \(e^{x} = 3x\) has two real roots, one in \([0, 1]\) and one in \([1, 2]\). Find both by the Newton-Raphson method correct to three decimal places, starting from \(x_0 = 0.5\) and \(x_0 = 1.5\). (5 marks)
(\(e^{x} = 3x\) ke do real roots hain, aik \([0, 1]\) mein aur aik \([1, 2]\) mein. Newton-Raphson se \(x_0 = 0.5\) aur \(x_0 = 1.5\) le kar dono teen decimal places tak nikalein.)

11 Use the Newton-Raphson method with \(x_0 = 1.5\) to find the positive root of \(x^{4} + x - 3 = 0\) correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Newton-Raphson se \(x_0 = 1.5\) le kar \(x^{4} + x - 3 = 0\) ka positive root do decimal places tak nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: is the root correct to the desired accuracy

blocks.prompt:
12 Derive the Trapezium Rule \(\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx \approx \frac{h}{2}[f(x_0) + 2f(x_1) + \dots + 2f(x_{n-1}) + f(x_n)]\) for a continuous \(f(x) \ge 0\) on \([a, b]\). (5 marks)
(Continuous \(f(x) \ge 0\) ke liye \([a, b]\) par Trapezium Rule akhaz karein.)
blocks.explanation: Area ko h chaurai ke n hisson mein kaatein, har hissa trapezium se badlein, aur areas jama karein.

book_ref.quote: represent the lengths of parallel sides of

steps: Andar wali har qeemat do brackets mein, kinare wali aik mein

blocks.prompt:
13 Use the Trapezium Rule with \(n = 5\) to approximate \(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{1 + x^{2}}\,dx\). Compare with the exact value \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) and hence estimate \(\pi\). (5 marks)
(Trapezium Rule, \(n = 5\), se \(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{1 + x^{2}}\,dx\) ka andaza lagayein. Exact qeemat \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) se muqabla karein aur \(\pi\) ka andaza nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(h = 0.2\); chhe points par \(\frac{1}{1 + x^{2}}\) chaar decimals tak, phir rule lagayein.

book_ref.quote: the accuracy of the approximation improves as n is taken sufficiently large

blocks.prompt:
14 Use the Trapezium Rule with \(n = 6\) to approximate \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin x\,dx\) and compare with the exact value. (5 marks)
(Trapezium Rule, \(n = 6\), se \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin x\,dx\) ka andaza lagayein aur exact qeemat se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(h = \frac{\pi}{12}\); radian mode, har qeemat chaar decimals tak.

book_ref.quote: For trigonometric functions put the calculator in radian mode.

steps: Exact \(= 1\); rule \(0.0057\) kam deta hai (curve neeche ko mudti hai)

blocks.prompt:
15 Use the Trapezium Rule with \(h = 1\) to approximate \(\int_{0}^{4} \frac{1}{1 + x}\,dx\). Find the exact value and the difference. (5 marks)
(Trapezium Rule, \(h = 1\), se \(\int_{0}^{4} \frac{1}{1 + x}\,dx\) ka andaza lagayein. Exact qeemat aur farq nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Yahan \(h\) diya hai, pehle \(n = \frac{b - a}{h}\); exact ke liye \(\int \frac{1}{u}\,du = \ln|u| + c\).

book_ref.quote: When an exact value can be found (as in Example 7), compare it with the trapezium value

steps: Farq \(0.0739\); curve oopar ko mudti hai is liye rule zyada deta hai

blocks.prompt:
16 The equilibrium concentration \(x\) (moles per liter) of a product satisfies \(xe^{2x} = 1\). Find \(x\) correct to two decimal places by the Newton-Raphson method. (5 marks)
(Aik product ki equilibrium concentration \(x\) (moles per liter) \(xe^{2x} = 1\) poori karti hai. Newton-Raphson se \(x\) do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = xe^{2x} - 1\), \(f'(x) = (1 + 2x)e^{2x}\) (product rule); sign change interval ke beech se shuru.

book_ref.quote: These equations are often difficult to solve analytically, so numerical methods are used to find approximate values.

blocks.prompt:
17 At steady state a heartbeat signal \(x\) satisfies \(x^{3} - 2x - 2 = 0\). Find the real root in \([1, 2]\) by the bisection method, correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Steady state par heartbeat signal \(x\), \(x^{3} - 2x - 2 = 0\) poora karta hai. Bisection se \([1, 2]\) mein real root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sign change dekhein, har baar interval aadha karein aur sign change wala hissa rakhein; 4 decimals.

book_ref.quote: The human heartbeat is regulated by electrical signals

blocks.prompt:
18 The voltage \(V\) (volts) across a component satisfies \(\sin V - 0.6V = 0\). Find the non-zero root in \([1, 2]\) by the Regula-Falsi method, correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Component par voltage \(V\) (volts), \(\sin V - 0.6V = 0\) poora karta hai. Regula-Falsi se \([1, 2]\) mein non-zero root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Radian mode; \(V = 0\) trivial root hai. \(f(b) < 0\) qaim, har positive \(f(V_c)\) \(a\) ko badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: In circuits, the voltage or current at certain points may satisfy nonlinear equations.

blocks.prompt:
19 A key parameter \(x\) satisfies \(x^{5} - 4x + 1 = 0\). Find its root in \([0, 1]\) by the Regula-Falsi method, correct to two decimal places. (5 marks)
(Key parameter \(x\), \(x^{5} - 4x + 1 = 0\) poora karta hai. Regula-Falsi se \([0, 1]\) mein root do decimal places tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Degree 5 ka koi formula nahin; sign change ke interval par secant ka andaza lein.

book_ref.quote: Cryptographic algorithms sometimes involve high-degree nonlinear equations
